database: Active FundFlow PostgreSQL on the external-drive project

nav_history.behavior: Only missing fund/date/currency rows were inserted. Existing values and conflicts were preserved.

portfolio_holdings.note: Committed registrar batches were retained. The full registrant sweep was stopped after an extended run; rerunning the idempotent command can continue the refresh.

official_identifiers.matching_rule: Exact ticker, compatible security name, one consistent CUSIP/ISIN pair, and valid ISIN check digit

twelve_data_comparison.note: Compared saved Twelve Data values against FundFlow's current same-date USD NAV values; a new Twelve Data API key is not configured.

limitations: Exact equality across all fields and all U.S. funds is not established by this ten-fund price sample.
Twelve Data and official-source values can differ in source precision, valuation basis, and timing; no vendor value was copied into FundFlow.
The public Nasdaq quote history endpoint is not formally versioned.
SEC N-PORT reports are filed/disseminated after their reporting period and do not cover all U.S. fund types.

repeatable_commands.nav_sample: ./.venv/bin/python scripts/refresh_us_nasdaq_nav_history.py --ticker VFIAX --ticker VTSAX --ticker FXAIX --ticker SWPPX --ticker FCNTX --ticker DODGX --ticker FBALX --ticker VWELX --ticker VBTLX --ticker VTIAX --history-days 365
repeatable_commands.twelvedata_compare: ./.venv/bin/python scripts/compare_twelvedata_universe.py --kind mutual_fund --tickers VFIAX VTSAX FXAIX SWPPX FCNTX DODGX FBALX VWELX VBTLX VTIAX --date YYYY-MM-DD
